name: Regina
registryBasis: The City of Regina's official Geospatial Team publishes the public CGISViewer/Taxweb ArcGIS service and an OpenData/Parcels service. The official service metadata identifies Tax Parcels and describes the City of Regina parcel/tax map; this is local municipal GIS evidence, not title or ownership access.

queries.query: site:regina.ca GIS parcel map Regina Saskatchewan official property parcels
queries.result: Results identified the official City of Regina Geospatial Team ArcGIS REST Taxweb service, the official OpenData/Parcels service, and the City map viewer.

queries.query: site:regina.ca carte parcelles Regina Saskatchewan GIS officiel
queries.result: No distinct French-language City result was returned; the same official Regina ArcGIS service records were returned and used for bounded inspection.

officialLeads.observation: MapServer metadata identifies Tax Parcels (layer 0), ArcGIS REST query support, CRS EPSG:26913, and GeoJSON support.

Service description is City of Regina Ownership Parcels; its exposed layer is ASSESSMENT_REGIONS and metadata includes OBJECTID, APN/APN_9, GLOBALID and geometry. Potentially sensitive account/tax fields were not requested.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: HTTP 200 ArcGIS service metadata retrieved; layer 0 is Tax Parcels, spatial reference 26913, supported query formats include GeoJSON.

HTTP 200 layer schema retrieved. Safe native identity is OBJECTID; geometry type is polygon; source fields also include address, assessed value, account and multi-account fields, which were not requested.

HTTP 200 layer schema retrieved for ASSESSMENT_REGIONS. It exposes polygon geometry and native OBJECTID, but this layer's role appears assessment-region/parcel publication rather than a clean parcel identity response.

HTTP 200 bounded anonymous query returned one polygon intersecting the transformed WUP point, with properties restricted to OBJECTID=15492. Full unchanged response retained only in ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/regina/tax-query.geojson; no retained sample was written.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal Regina Taxweb parcel layer and City OpenData parcel-service metadata; one bounded parcel geometry response was verified.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The Taxweb service extent and one point-intersection response establish service availability, not citywide completeness or update cadence.
coverageAssessment.exactPointResult: The exact WUP point was transformed only for the EPSG:26913 request and returned one intersecting polygon; the WUP point itself remains unchanged in city metadata.

blocker: A real first-party ID-plus-geometry response is verified, but independent serial qualification and adapter admission have not occurred; source semantics and citywide coverage remain outside this research packet.
remainingUncertainty: The public Taxweb layer exposes additional address, assessed-value, account and multi-account fields that were intentionally excluded. The OpenData/Parcels layer's ASSESSMENT_REGIONS naming requires separate qualification before treating it as the canonical parcel adapter source. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception were used.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should qualify the Taxweb polygon layer, native OBJECTID identity, CRS transformation and safe-field projection independently before runtime admission.
